evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Missing entirely. Rep launches into details without framing the time commitment or promise of a dependable quote, and without waiting for customer affirmation before proceeding.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep moves directly into logistics probing without asking: 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?'
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — customer did raise concerns about packing heavy boxes (I pack them heavy and then I can't move them) and scheduling constraints (Walmart schedule, can't take days off in November). Calvin acknowledged with 'Gotcha, yeah yeah' but did not probe deeper with 'tell me more about that' on either concern.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: N/A — no summary reflection. Customer raised multiple concerns but rep did not recap them back for confirmation.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Partial. Covered: property type (2-bed apartment), moving distance (2 miles), special items (antique bookcase, many books, clothes, kitchen items). Missing: floor/stories, number of rooms (inferred 2-bed but not confirmed), walking distance to door, additional rooms, additional stops. Property size not stated.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: True — rep explicitly offered and discussed full packing services.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: False. Rep estimated 3.5–5.5 hours for packing and mentioned 'you'll end up probably with good amount of boxes' but never asked the typical-count question or overflow check.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Full. Rep provided anchored range for packing (3.5–5.5 hours, $945–$1,361 including supplies) and moving (3–5.5 hours, $728–$1,144), and personalized by noting customer's plan to pre-pack some items and the mixed-model option (pack day + move day vs. one day).
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Full. Trip fees disclosed upfront (none), taxes noted (none), no credit card fees, supplies broken down ($217), 2.5-hour minimum mentioned ('once we go over the two and a half hour mark'), hourly rate clearly stated ($208/hr for 2-man crew).
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Rep moved directly into the 'here's what I'll do' close without ever asking 'Does that feel fair?' or similar validation checkpoint and holding silence.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Full. 'if we're ever late to any windows of arrival that we give you we do discount you money back.' Discount terms clear.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Full. 'No worries. Damage coverage that allocates up to $2,000 per move just to cover any damages that may occur. We just go well above and beyond the industry standard of 60¢ per pound.' Built-in framing present; no deductible or fine print mentioned, but stated as standard inclusion.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: False. Rep did not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or similar. The Two Promises were stated as features but not presented as answers to customer concerns or validated with customer.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. Rep did not ask 'What's still concerning you about this move?' Rep ended with 'if you have any questions that do pop-up let us know' — generic throwaway, not a genuine final-concerns probe.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: False. Never asked 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?'
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never. Rep never asked 'Would you like our help with your move?' or equivalent. Instead, rep assumed no booking and pivoted to email + wait-for-contact flow: 'I think you're not probably ready to book a date at this time... I'll send over this estimate... if you're ready to get on the calendar... once the date gets lined up, just reach out.'
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: False. No mention of rate locking in the booking or estimate framing.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Rep confirmed: no deposit needed, no cancellation fee. Did not confirm: specific date (customer explicitly said not ready until November schedule released), phone number, arrival window, crew size, final addresses, or notes for crew about bookcase/heavy boxes concern. Rep sent customer to email flow instead of confirming details live.

top_strength: Calvin gathered rich discovery details about the customer's move (antique bookcase, heavy packing habit, book collection, clothes volume, Walmart schedule constraints) and provided detailed, transparent, anchored pricing with clear fee disclosure and genuine Two Promises framing — the estimate itself was well-structured and personalized.
coaching_note: Never ask for the business. Calvin assumed the customer wasn't ready and pivoted to email without ever asking 'Would you like our help with your move?' — the call ended without a genuine close attempt, and no booking details (date, phone, window, addresses, crew notes) were confirmed on the call itself.
